intent: evopilot-harness v4.4.0 minimal acceptance closure with one complete real WorkBuddy production lifecycle, deterministic multi-run conformance, and four engine-owned harness business phases
objective: Close v4.4.0 acceptance without changing product behavior: preserve professional Source-to-Harness reasoning and every governed Harness decision as deterministic and Engine-owned, accept at least one complete fresh zero-to-one WorkBuddy production lifecycle as real-host evidence, and retain deterministic multi-run plus cross-Host conformance for Frame structure, business semantics, bound language, finite decision options, and lifecycle order.

include: Define versioned BusinessDecisionView, ComplianceAuditEnvelope, SourceToHarnessReasoningMap, and DecisionDefinition schemas
Generate decision-relevant business content deterministically from authoritative Engine and Session objects without Host-LLM authorship
Preserve complete technical objects, authority, digests, permitted operations, receipts, model usage, and recovery metadata in an exportable ComplianceAuditEnvelope
Bind create, reuse, evolve, compose, reject, and need-more-evidence conclusions to immutable Source Evidence, uncertainty, alternatives, non-adoption reasons, and Catalog relationships
Implement Agent Operations Protocol v3, Interaction Frame v2, finite Engine-declared decision options, composite decision bindings, and automatic non-authoritative presentation receipts
Keep WorkBuddy and all generated adapters limited to attachment transport, exact rendering, Host UI, MCP invocation, and explicit decision transport
Fail closed on Host omission, rewriting, reordering, summarization, stale binding, ambiguous decisions, unsupported capability, or chat-memory recovery
Preserve v4.3 Protocol v2 Session read, diagnosis, cancellation, safe close, and explicit migration without fabricated v3 presentation evidence
Cover Plan, Evidence, Proposal Review, approval, publication, blocker, retry, recovery, cancellation, close, and cleanup business views
Update Digital Expert Core and generate WorkBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, Generic, and MCP adapters from one authority
Add an architecture ADR refining ADR 0002 without changing ADR 0001 product ownership
Run deterministic schema, rendering, state-machine, tamper, compatibility, package, and cross-host tests
Rerun the real WorkBuddy code-generation-prompt DOCX lifecycle from an isolated candidate npm package
Run the same authoritative case through at least one independent compatible Host and prove business-content digest equality
Synchronize Roadmap, architecture, protocol, migration, Digital Expert, operator, and acceptance documentation
Bind complete v4.3.0 acceptance lineage, deterministic regression impact, four production-like real cases, ALL_REQUIRED_PASS closure, and NO_REGRESSION evidence
Bundle the exact isolated Harness MCP server through WorkBuddy's supported expert-plugin MCP surface instead of treating a root configuration file as active-session registration
Distinguish declared MCP configuration, registered plugin MCP, runtime process connectivity, tool discovery, and successful inspect_capabilities handshake in installer status
Fail closed before generic attachment analysis when the current Agent-host session cannot call the bound Harness MCP server
Verify MCP persistence across WorkBuddy restart and a fresh expert conversation before reporting READY
Define Engine-owned versioned presentation templates with primary business, professional detail, and compliance audit layers
Add deterministic task navigation, risk tiers, business decision cards, Plan/Proposal differences, Evidence confidence, and recovery summaries
Reject Host or model additions, omissions, translations, reordering, option drift, technical leakage, and any non-canonical rendering

Prove one complete fresh real WorkBuddy production lifecycle and retain deterministic multi-run plus independent-Host conformance for governed Engine Frame structure, business semantics, bound language, finite decision options, and lifecycle order
Declare versioned long-running MCP capabilities for every supported Host, including its maximum synchronous request window and reconnect/resume support
Generate the WorkBuddy expert plugin with an explicit verified MCP request timeout that survives install, upgrade, and restart
Define an Engine-owned OperationJob contract binding Job identity to Session digest, operation, input digest, status, result digest, and retry classification
Provide synchronous and asynchronous Proposal Review paths backed by the same Engine implementation and identical authoritative results
Recover disconnects, timeouts, restarts, reconnects, and repeated starts idempotently without repeating an uncertain Engine or LLM mutation
Resume the unchanged real WorkBuddy Session and complete its Proposal Review and remaining revision 5 lifecycle before Acceptance Closure
Replace single-Frame replay sufficiency with complete ordered lifecycle Frame-set replay for the real WorkBuddy DOCX case

Require at least one complete zero-to-one WorkBuddy production run from a fresh Workspace, Session, and task covering Operation Plan; professional Source-to-Harness analysis and Proposal Review; Proposal human decision; and publication plus Session lifecycle decisions
Compare canonicalMarkdown, renderedBusinessViewDigest, businessViewDigest, decisionDefinitionDigest, stage order, finite choices, locale, and visible text at every corresponding stage
Require two full WorkBuddy restarts, a model switch, cross-day recovery, and independent-Host replay across the complete lifecycle Frame set

Exclude Host-owned chrome, loading, model-reasoning, and transport status from governed Frame comparison while failing acceptance on any Host rewrite, obstruction, replacement, acknowledgement, confirmation, decision inference, option drift, or unauthorized lifecycle advance
Use immutable Frame and audit replay for repetition evidence so replay cannot repeat approval, publication, close, cleanup, or Source-side effects

Define versioned HarnessProfessionalAnalysis, HarnessArchitectureAssessment, SourceOutcomeExplanation, EvolutionContextBinding, AgentHostBoundaryContract, HostConformanceProfile, and CanonicalPresentationDeliveryReceipt contracts

Explain every accepted capability through exact Source evidence, deterministic extraction and normalization, Ontology mapping, Catalog comparison, alternatives, counter-evidence, confidence, architecture impact, Evaluation coverage, and known limits

Represent REUSE_EXISTING, EVOLVE_EXISTING, COMPOSE_NEW_BUNDLE, PROPOSE_NEW_PROFILE, NOT_HARNESS_ELIGIBLE, NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE, NO_CHANGE, and REJECT as finite Engine-owned outcomes with professional explanations

Run every governed stage through a versioned Engine-owned presentation sandbox with fixed locale, fixed field order, fixed omission rules, schema validation, canonicalMarkdown, and exact whole-turn delivery receipts

Bind Source snapshot, Catalog, OntologyPack, MatchPolicyPack, AdvisorPolicyPack, non-secret Advisor profile identity, operation intent, locale, and presentation-template version into one immutable Evolution Context
Reuse an unchanged authoritative result for the same Source and Evolution Context, and create a new traceable Context plus deterministic old/new differences only for explicit reevaluation

Prove at least one fresh complete real WorkBuddy production lifecycle while deterministic multi-run and cross-Host tests retain equivalent governed Frame structure and semantics; treat run-specific Workspace, Session, Job, receipt, timestamp, and digest identities as typed bindings rather than literal-byte equality
Negotiate and enforce third-party Host conformance so unsupported rendering, receipt, interception, locale, or MCP capabilities fail closed before a governed lifecycle
Run the professional positive DOCX case, unsuitable, insufficient-evidence, no-change, and reject cases, plus WorkBuddy, independent-Host, weak-Host, and hostile-Host conformance scenarios
exclude: Changing Proposal Review verdict or Evaluation scoring semantics
Allowing Agent-host or Host-LLM ownership of Harness reasoning, decision definitions, lifecycle state, approval, or publication
Automatic Plan approval, Proposal approval, Catalog publication, retry, cancellation, close, or cleanup
Executing Source projects, attachments, prompts, build commands, tests, deployment, or business operations
Embedding a general-purpose Agent runtime or conversational model
Borrowing the WorkBuddy conversation model as Harness Advisor or Proposal reviewer
EvoPilot Goal Loop execution, project onboarding, or project release decisions
GHCR, containers, cloud, remote-service, or deployment capabilities
Commit, push, tag, GitHub Release, npm publication, or Harness Asset publication
Repeated Catalog mutation or duplicate Harness asset publication solely to prove rendering equality
Treating repeated rendering of one Frame, replay of an existing Session, or comparison of the complete WorkBuddy page as evidence for a complete fresh real WorkBuddy production lifecycle
Cleanup of the real acceptance Session
Changing Codex EvoPilot Skill Suite behavior or installing software-architecture Skills into the Harness product
Predetermining a Java DDD, component-count, Profile, Bundle, or Proposal conclusion independently of authoritative Engine evidence and current Evolution Context

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: A regression fixture with at least 13 Evidence Sources deterministically reproduces a first semantic-review response that omits multiple required project memberships and proves that a source-id-only repair request is insufficient.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Multi-source regression fixture, captured validation result, and repair-request projection assertions

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Every semantic-review repair request contains the complete immutable required source projection, and the final canonical membership preserves exact Engine-owned sourceId, sourceType, sourceRef, and sourceDigest values while retaining model-authored status, rationale, and evidenceIds.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Positive repair-path tests and exact field-level identity assertions

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Missing, duplicate, unknown, identity-mutated, empty-reference, invalid-evidence, and cross-source-cited memberships are rejected; a failed repair remains BLOCKED and cannot advance to Proposal approval or publication.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Negative contract matrix and Session gate assertions

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: A real WorkBuddy Desktop run from an isolated v4.3.0 candidate package uses the same document and user-owned glm-5.1 configuration to complete Proposal Review and visibly render the complete canonical Review frame without Proposal approval or publication.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Redacted WorkBuddy transcript, screenshots, structured MCP receipts, Session digests, and candidate-package provenance

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run the code-generation-prompt DOCX lifecycle in real WorkBuddy from the isolated v4.4.0 candidate package through Plan, evidence, Proposal Review, approval, publication, Catalog validation, Engine-owned close decision, and safe close without cleanup.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Redacted WorkBuddy transcript and screenshots, candidate provenance, Session and business-content digests, decision count, reasoning map, audit envelope, Catalog validation, close Frame, and safe-close receipt

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run the same authoritative DOCX case through an independent compatible Host and prove authoritative business-content digest equality with WorkBuddy.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Cross-Host transcript, authoritative object bindings, identical business-content digests, and semantic-diff report limited to layout or transport metadata

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Install and operate the exact v4.4.0 candidate npm package in an isolated environment without resolving or reading the source checkout.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Pack manifest, package digest, isolated install log, runtime provenance, MCP tool discovery, and sourceCheckoutUsed=false assertion

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Replay the v4.3.0 thirteen-source Proposal Review repair and Protocol v2 compatibility/migration regression against the v4.4.0 candidate.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Thirteen-source repair matrix, Protocol v2 read/diagnose/cancel/close results, migration negative/idempotency evidence, and no fabricated presentation evidence

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Complete the real WorkBuddy DOCX production lifecycle from zero to one in at least one distinct fresh Workspace, Session, and task using the governed inputs; require all four Engine-owned Harness business phases in order while excluding isolated Host-owned Surface status from comparison and retaining deterministic cross-Host conformance.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: One complete fresh-run provenance manifest, complete persisted WorkBuddy/Engine lifecycle evidence, four-phase ordered manifest, Host-Surface exclusion report, and deterministic independent-Host comparison

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Verify the professional business presentation templates generalize across code generation, API and architecture, testing and security, and operations Harness evolution cases.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Domain-neutral golden fixtures and template completeness results

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run a Proposal Review longer than the original WorkBuddy MCP request window, force a controlled disconnect, reconnect to the same Engine-owned OperationJob, and prove at-most-once Review execution with authoritative cross-host result equality.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Candidate provenance, Host capability declaration, timeout configuration, Job and Session digests, disconnect/reconnect timeline, reviewer invocation count, authoritative result equality, redacted transcript, and screenshots

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Analyze the read-only code-generation-prompt DOCX and present a professional positive Source-to-Harness assessment with exact Source basis, extraction method, Catalog alternatives, architecture and evolution recommendation, Evaluation coverage, confidence, counter-evidence, and known limits without preselecting the conclusion.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Candidate provenance, Source snapshot digest, professional-analysis and architecture-assessment objects, canonical Chinese business view, reasoning map, Catalog comparison, and cross-Host digests

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Analyze a Source that is not eligible to become reusable Harness knowledge and return NOT_HARNESS_ELIGIBLE with exact failed criteria, evidence, alternatives, and safe user guidance without generating a Proposal.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Unsuitable Source fixture, Eligibility result, SourceOutcomeExplanation, canonical business view, unchanged Proposal store, and audit envelope

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Analyze a Source whose evidence is insufficient and return NEED_MORE_EVIDENCE with the exact missing evidence, uncertainty, protected state, and deterministic resumption guidance without inventing capability or Proposal content.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Insufficient-evidence fixture, missing-evidence matrix, SourceOutcomeExplanation, zero invented citations, and unchanged Catalog/Proposal state

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Analyze a Source already fully covered by the current Catalog and return NO_CHANGE with matching evidence, comparison, and non-duplication reason.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Existing Catalog fixture, exact-match score, SourceOutcomeExplanation, no duplicate Proposal, and canonical business view

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Analyze a Source with conflicting evidence, unsafe boundary, or invalid proposed evolution and return REJECT with counter-evidence, affected boundary, safe alternatives, and no state mutation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Reject fixture, boundary or conflict findings, SourceOutcomeExplanation, no mutation assertion, and audit envelope

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run the professional Source-to-Harness lifecycle from zero to one at least once with a fresh Workspace, Session, and task identity, while deterministic equivalent-input tests compare governed Frames by normalized structure and semantics rather than literal run-specific bytes.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: One complete fresh-run manifest plus deterministic equivalent-input matrix, normalized per-phase Frame comparison, run-specific typed-binding report, invocation counters, and conformance result

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Run the professional DOCX lifecycle at least once in real WorkBuddy from a fresh Workspace, Session, and task with the v4.4.0 candidate, Source, Harness configuration, Catalog and policy baseline, locale, and explicit user decisions; the run must present Operation Plan, professional analysis and Proposal Review, Proposal human decision, and publication plus Session lifecycle decisions through safe close without cleanup.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: One redacted complete WorkBuddy lifecycle record with fresh Workspace/Session/task evidence, candidate provenance, four-phase conformance report, Session archive, and safe-close evidence

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Present the same authoritative professional lifecycle through an independent conformant Host; permit isolated Host chrome, loading, reasoning-status, and transport-status surfaces, while hostile and weak Hosts attempt rewriting, translation, obstruction, replacement, omission, reordering, Harness-semantic wrapper prose, technical injection into Frames, chat-memory recovery, inferred approval, unauthorized acknowledgement or confirmation, stale or incomplete receipt, and unsupported governed capability.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Positive governed-Frame structure and semantic-equivalence report, Host-Surface exclusion matrix, Host capability profiles, delivery receipts, negative conformance matrix, unchanged Session and Workspace digests, and zero unauthorized state advances
